caption: A charcoal chimney starter is lit, and flames and smoke rise up through the coals from the paper burning below.

sa.check: A charcoal chimney starter is filled with coals.
Flames rise up through the coals.
Smoke pours out of the top.
The fire starts at the bottom.
The order is paper lit below, flames climb, smoke at the top.

pc.expect: The flames and smoke travel upward through the coals and out of the chimney's top.
pc.fail: The flames start at the top and travel down; or the smoke pours out of the bottom and sinks to the ground; or the flames point downward out of the base; or the smoke hangs as a fixed shape without rising.

pc.expect: The fire only climbs: the coals catch from the bottom upward and lit coals stay lit.
pc.fail: A lit coal turns back to cold black charcoal; or the fire starts at the top of the chimney; or the flames climb and then fall back to the paper leaving the coals cold; or the paper below turns back into unburnt paper.

pc.expect: The paper burning below feeds the flames and the coals above it begin to glow.
pc.fail: The paper burns and the coals above stay untouched and cold to the end of the clip; or the coals glow while the paper below is unlit; or the flames appear in the middle of the chimney with the paper below unlit.

pc.expect: The coals stay hard lumps that glow and shift as they settle and the paper chars and crumbles, while the chimney stays a rigid metal can.
pc.fail: A coal melts or flows; or the coals swell up and fill the chimney; or the paper melts and drips; or the chimney's metal sags or bulges.

pc.expect: One chimney with its coals; the coals keep their number and stay inside until the chimney is tipped.
pc.fail: A coal vanishes; or new coals appear with none added; or a coal passes through the chimney's wall; or the chimney changes shape.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The chimney's handle, the ground and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The handle changes shape; or the ground changes texture; or items around the chimney rearrange.
